method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (cdb-core.l4, with five regulative rules) and a seat layer (cdb-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a person not eligible gets an explicit answer naming the condition, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Canada Disability Benefit Act, S.C. 2023, c. 17, and Canada Disability Benefit Regulations, SOR/2025-35, Justice Laws consolidation current to 2026-09-30 (Act last amended 2024-06-22; Regulations 2026-09-01), from justicecanada/laws-lois-xml commit 0507465393c224c0491fc8c17c88340217acc656, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/S.C.-2023-c.-17.txt and SOR-2025-35.txt. The indexing factor is 1 for the payment period beginning July 2025; for later periods the CPI figures are inputs.

scope: From the seat of the person applying for the Canada disability benefit: Act ss 4-6; Regulations s 1, s 2(1)-(6), ss 2.1, 6.1, 9.1, s 5, s 6(1)-(7), s 7, s 8(2), s 11(3), ss 18-19, s 37(1); duties under Act s 6 and Regulations ss 11(3), 18, 19(1), 37(1) as regulative rules. Out: first-payment arrears, monthly mechanics, suspension by the Minister, applications before 18, death and presumption of death, representatives, administrative errors, appeals and Tax Court references, compliance, penalties, offences, recovery. Read with subjects/ca/income-tax-act/ (DTC eligibility, adjusted income, working income, cohabiting spouse, returns); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the person with a disability applying for or receiving the Canada disability benefit
